title: General projective projections are locally immersions or etale at a fixed nonsingular point
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: One must produce one nonempty parameter open avoiding both secant identifications and tangent collapse. The proof constructs two incidence schemes with strict dimension bounds, removes their constructible images, and then combines finiteness, tangent injectivity and the single-fibre criterion to obtain a local immersion or etaleness.
